mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, we are seeing overcast skies with a temperature of 64 degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School.

Deputy Chief Liz Gay officially joins the city team today. She brings extensive experience in emergency operations and instructor development from her previous work with Mercyhealth and Fitch-Rona EMS. Also, as a reminder, Pellitteri Waste Systems handles our refuse and recycling, so be sure your carts are out by 7 AM.

It is a busy day for trivia lovers in Verona! You can catch Hop Haus Trivia, Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee, or Dream Day Trivia, all taking place today. Looking ahead to tomorrow, check out live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, or the Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher special at Lake Lou-ee.

In a notable call from early last Saturday, October 25, officers located a 40-year-old man in his vehicle at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue. He was taken into custody for an O W I, first offence.
The delicious flavor of the day is Turtle Cheesecake. Our local Culver's is currently closed but will be ready to serve you when they open today at 10:00 AM.
